intro: The Tome of Divinity is an introductory summons calling young dwarven paladins from their field duties in Dun Morogh to the mountain city of Ironforge. Dispatched by Azar Stronghammer, the initiate is directed to seek guidance from Tiza Battleforge high in the Hall of Mysteries. It marks the formal beginning of a paladin's deeper trials in service to the Holy Light.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hello, friend. I know you're busy helping out the people of Dun Morogh, but when you have the time, you should make your way up to Ironforge to speak to one of our most respected ilk: Tiza Battleforge. She's the one the younger paladins go to when it's time they learn more about the Light and what's expected of ya.
You can find her upstairs in the Hall of Mysteries. If you've never been there, it's in the Mystic Ward. Good luck to ya, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well met, friend. I hope the Light shows you the true path and keeps you safe from evil.
